prompt: Create a transparent PNG sprite source sheet for an original pixel-art wuxia RPG. Exactly FOUR animation cels in ONE HORIZONTAL ROW, equal square cells, fully separated with wide transparent gutters. Each cel is only ONE SIMPLE GOLDEN LIGHT RING, hollow transparent center, thin ivory-gold inner edge and warm amber outer edge. A smooth continuous circle projected as a modestly flattened ground ellipse in a three-quarter overhead RPG view. NO spikes, NO stars, NO leaves, NO lotuses, NO runes, NO formation, NO particles, NO central light column, NO extra rings. Four successive pulse stages: small bright ring; medium bright ring; broad thinner ring; broad faint fading ring. Identical center point in all four cells. Crisp pixel edges, restrained glow integrated into the raster, no blurred cloudy aura, no labels or grid lines, no black matte or checkerboard. Keep every ring fully inside its cell with transparent margins. This replaces an overly ornate radial shockwave with a single plain light ring expanding from the boss center. Source sprite artwork only, not a UI/concept montage.
